function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content:
Shashi Tej Reddy is a former Indian Army officer who later entered politics in the state of Telangana, India.  
He served in the Indian Army for several years, holding command positions and earning a reputation for disciplined leadership. After retiring from the military, he joined the Indian National Congress and contested the Lok Sabha (House of the People) elections from the Nalgonda constituency in 2014 and again in 2019. In both contests he was defeated by the incumbent candidates.  

Reddy’s political profile is largely tied to his military background and his attempts to bring that experience into parliamentary representation for his home region.
